name: Kamikatsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamikatsu town emblem in yellow: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikatsu, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 December 1965.

features.role: Kamikatsu town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised arrowhead
